multiply_quaternions: multiply two quaternion tensors using qmul to compute the product of rotations
rotate_vectors_with_quaternion: rotate 3D vectors about a rotation described by quaternion q using qrot
convert_quaternion_to_euler: convert quaternion tensor to Euler angles in a specified rotation order using qeuler
fix_quaternion_continuity: enforce quaternion continuity across time dimension by selecting minimal distance representation using qfix
convert_expmap_to_quaternion: convert axis-angle exponential map rotations to quaternions using expmap_to_quaternion
